title: The Built–Operate–Sustain Signature Model

phases.objective: Create the commercial architecture to enter or accelerate a platform in a specific market
phases.scope: Market and category assessment · ICP and account segmentation · product-market narrative · GTM strategy · pricing and commercial review · strategic account universe · GCC's and GSI's mapping · partner proposition · pipeline architecture · sales assets · 90-day operating plan
phases.proof: A documented GTM blueprint plus an executable account, partner and pipeline plan. An operating system for commercial execution, not a slide deck.

phases.objective: Work alongside platform leadership to create actual commercial traction
phases.scope: Strategic account pursuit · executive meetings · pipeline generation · partner activation · GCC's opportunity development · GSI's orchestration · deal strategy · weekly forecast cadence · lighthouse customer development · reference creation
phases.proof: Pipeline, qualified opportunities, executive relationships, active partners, customer wins, and a repeatable commercial rhythm.

phases.objective: Keep the growth engine strengthening, expanding and increasingly client-owned
phases.scope: Customer trust & relationship depth · adoption & value realisation · continuous value reviews · expansion motions · quarterly GTM optimisation · playbooks · coaching · governance · partner scorecards · account planning · dashboards
phases.proof: A client-owned GTM capability that keeps strengthening and expanding — with Pivora engaged as strategic partner. Sustain is a continuing partnership, not a handover.
